## Summary

Tautvilas Kęstutaitis (baptised Kondrat, 21 Oct 1383), younger brother of Vytautas, fights on the Order's side and is killed at the siege of Vilnius in 1390.

## Record vs saga

- **[Record]:** Son of Kęstutis and Birutė (VLE, Tautvila 1). Killed besieging the Crooked Castle at Vilnius in September 1390, "believed killed by a crossbow bolt" (Wigand / Marburgietis; en.wikipedia, Siege of Vilnius 1390). VLE's "9-10 June" is nonsensical: the siege ran 11 Sep - 7 Oct. Fought on the Order's side, not as a hostage at Lyck.
- **[Saga invention]:** The shooter is unknown in the book (Book II ch. 7 replaced the axe duel with a bolt at the gate); Sofija's letter in ch. 8 reports it so.
